text:
ida: Heads-up — invoice-preview jumped ~1.9x for tenant t-sigma after the routing fallback roll yesterday. early traces show the same request_id emitted under two different origin keys when the client switched transport mid-session. ledger dedupes; preview sums -> visible spike.

engops: Oof. sample?

ida: sanitized trace: 
{"request_id":"req-2026","tenant":"t-sigma","origin_key":"edge-A","transport":"ws","tokens":102}
...later...
{"request_id":"req-2026","tenant":"t-sigma","origin_key":"edge-B","transport":"http","tokens":98}

pm: So preview pipeline groups by origin_key which changed; ledger de-dupes by request_id. Two immediate paths: 1) short-term: make preview coalesce by request_id when present, 2) long-term: produce a stable billing_identity upstream that survives retries and header rotation.

sam: Short-term sounds fastest. We can patch preview-guardian (the preview aggregator) to prefer request_id grouping during the window. That avoids any Kafka partitioning changes.

engops: Agree. Caveat: ~6% of events still lack request_id (legacy SDKs/proxies). For those we'll keep the existing composite key. We'll also emit a sampled metric for missing ids so we know coverage.

ida: Can you sketch the quick patch?

sam: Pseudocode (windowed reducer):
```
// collect events in window
map = {}
for e in events:
  if e.request_id:
    map['req:'+e.request_id].tokens += e.tokens
  else:
    map['orig:'+e.tenant+':'+e.origin_key].tokens += e.tokens
emit all map entries
```
We'll gate behind feature flag preview.guardian.coalesce_by_request (default off) and add a 1% instrumented sampling for events without request_id.

pm: Roll plan?

sam: Canary: 5% tenants for 30m, compare preview vs ledger delta and CPU. If delta improves and no perf issues, ramp 25% -> 100% over ~4 hours. Rollback = flip flag.

metering-bot: Created MET-9002: "preview double-count from origin_key rotation" and attached traces.

engops: For long-term we should emit billing_identity from route-decider or edge proxies. Proposal: billing_identity = stable hash(tenant|session_id|sticky_cookie) returned in ingestion headers and persisted TTL 24h. proto sketch below: 
```
message IngestEnvelope {
  string request_id = 1;
  string tenant = 2;
  string origin_key = 3;
  optional string billing_identity = 4; // stable identity for billing joins
  int32 tokens = 5;
}
```
Keep optional so old consumers continue to work. Consumers should fallback to request_id/origin_key if billing_identity missing.

pm: Migration concerns: changing Kafka partition key to tenant|billing_identity affects rebalancing. We need a dual-write mode (write both keys) for at least 48-72h and a rekeying compaction job to backfill historical partitions. Also add monitoring for partition skew and consumer lag.

ida: Add telemetry requirements: (1) gauge preview_vs_ledger_delta by tenant, (2) histogram token_delta_on_origin_change, (3) metric billing_identity_coverage per tenant (percent events with billing_identity/request_id). Alert if preview_vs_ledger_delta > 12% for any top-50 tenant.

sam: I'll add a lightweight debug header x-billing-debug=true we can enable for a tenant for short windows; it will tag events so we can trace them without full sampling. Also add x-billing-identity for manual overrides during testing.

engops: SDK teams should be informed — encourage SDKs to preserve request_id and optionally set x-billing-identity when session_id known. Also add proxy shim that injects billing_identity when route-decider returns it.

pm: Owners + action items: sam -> implement preview.guardian patch + canary (MET-9002); engops -> draft proto RFC and dual-write migration plan; ida -> update dashboards and configure alert; sam & engops -> add debug header flow and sampling. Target: mitigation canary today; RFC by end of day tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled at 6951234700 to canary cluster. Shadow-run metrics will be posted to the ticket.

sam: Opening PR now with tests + perf bench. Will include toggle and sampled logs for missing request_id. ETA for canary: ~90 minutes.

ida: Thanks — this gets us breathing room and a cleaner long-term design. Keep this thread updated with canary metrics. :thumbsup:
